matt_s: Heads-up — we're bootstrapping the sfo-gpu2 cluster networking tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final sign-off on TGW peering, egress/NAT plan, and Route53 delegation. Who can join for a quick pre-check? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jia: I can be there. Quick checklist I want in place before we attach: TGW route tables pre-created, prefix lists for service CIDRs, and a security review for the cluster subnet egress rules.

sara-ops: +1. Also need a decision: per-az NAT gateways (higher cost, simpler) vs single centralized egress NAT GW behind a HA pair (cheaper but needs SNAT/connection tracking ops). Budget team flagged NAT cost growth.

andrew.k: If traffic is mostly model downloads, centralized egress + caching will save cash. If there's a lot of ephemeral outbound calls from pods, per-AZ NAT avoids cross-AZ charges and reduces latency. We should capture expected egress p95 before deciding.

net-eng: For TGW specifics: we'll create one TGW in prod-account and attach the new sfo account VPC. Plan to enable route propagation and create an explicit route table for the GPU cluster subnets. Remember to attach Transit Gateway Route Table ID to the attachment.

matt_s: Good. Action items for pre-boot (tomorrow T-1h):
- net-eng: create TGW attachment + route table (tgw-rt-gpu-sfo)
- jia: push cluster subnet CIDRs to the TGW prefix-list (pl-cluster-subnets)
- sara-ops: confirm NAT approach + budget approval
- andrew.k: prepare smoke egress test and cache config

matt_s: Also DNS: we'll create a private hosted zone in Route53 "svc.internal.redwood.sfo" and delegate it from the org-level private zone. Need the NS set to be added in the parent zone. Any objections to split-horizon?

jia: No objections. For delegation: ensure the Zone ID for the new hosted zone is shared with infra-automation so the terraform can create the NS records in the parent. Also confirm VPC associations for the zone before traffic goes live.

net-eng: Note on BGP/propagation: we're not doing BGP over TGW for this attach; relying on AWS route propagation. If we need more complex BGP with on-prem, we'll escalate.

sara-ops: NAT cost note — if we use per-AZ NAT GW, estimate ~$0.045 per GB outbound + NAT gateway hourly. If heavy egress predicted, we should use egress proxy + Squid/varnish in sfo or a private caching layer. That can cut data egress by caching model artifacts.

matt_s: Good call. For validation during bring-up, we should run this checklist:
1) TGW attachment state = available and associated to tgw-rt-gpu-sfo
2) Route table entries exist for cluster CIDRs -> TGW (show `rtb-` entries)
3) From a cluster node: `curl -sS http://ifconfig.co` -> expected egress IP (validate NAT EIP)
4) traceroute to external endpoint to confirm path hits NAT GW (check hop to EIP)
5) DNS resolution for `k8s-api.svc.internal.redwood.sfo` returns cluster-private IPs
6) Internal service discovery: `dig +short _model._tcp.svc.internal.redwood.sfo`
7) Security groups & NACLs allow cluster control plane and worker egress to required services
8) Infra-liveness: `systemctl status flanneld` / `kubectl get nodes` smoke

andrew.k: I'll prepare a small smoke script we can run from the bootstrap host that does 1-4 and posts results to the thread. Will include `curl -I`, `dig`, `traceroute`, and a simple `kubectl get pods -A --no-headers`.

deploy-bot: TGW attachment template created in IaC repo: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/tgw/merge_requests/42 :white_check_mark:

net-eng: A couple of gotchas we've hit before:
- Remember to disable source/dest check on any NAT instance if we go that route.
- Route propagation can take ~30s after attach; don't fail validation immediately.
- If using prefix-lists, ensure the size won't exceed the account limit; split into multiple if needed.

sara-ops: Handoff: after successful validation, we'll tag the run `sfo-gpu2-net-live` and hand to platform-oncall. Platform-oncall will own the DNS & monitoring for 72h. Who is oncall tomorrow? @andrew.k?

andrew.k: I'm oncall and can take the 72h. I'll also enable extra VPC Flow Log sampling for the new subnets for 24h so we can audit unexpected egress.

matt_s: Perfect. Final ask: net-eng, please paste the TGW RT ID + CIDR list into the thread once created. ops-bot, create a follow-up reminder at +2h post-attach for validation re-check.

deploy-bot: Reminder created for 2 hours after attachment (id: rmdr-8821).

matt_s: Thanks team — 09:00 PT tomorrow. We'll meet in #eng-infra briefly at T-15m. :rocket:
